subject: design/plangate-slice-coverage
statement: a plan's fold checks coverage against its **own coverage matrix** — the plan's slice — never against the whole feature: every requirement the matrix claims must be **live** and map to ≥1 task, and every task must map to ≥1 requirement or design anchor (the internal-consistency + fog bar plan-new-v1 already enforces, minus the "every feature Must" demand). Feature-level Must completeness is a **separate** check: the **union** of all the feature's plans' matrices must cover every live Must FR/UB, and a live Must covered by no plan is a named **feature-level** coverage defect — surfaced by a feature-coverage check, *never* as a per-plan fold block (`design-brainstorm` n/a; direct from FR-26). So a frozen plan stays green after a later amendment, an amendment is planned by a new slice-plan covering only its new requirements, and no Must is silently dropped. Concrete forms (the gate signatures, the matrix-as-slice read, the feature-union check) live in the paired solution-shape.
